---
name: 功能请求 / Feature Request
title: "[Feature] "
about: 提议新功能或改进 / Propose a new feature or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## 需求描述 / Description

你想新增或改进什么功能？解决什么问题？
What do you want to add or improve? What problem does it solve?

## 使用场景 / Use Case

在什么场景下会用到它？请尽量具体。
In what scenario would you use it? Be as specific as possible.

## 参考实现 / Reference

是否有其他项目（如 Iris、Sodium、OptiFine 或其他模组）的类似实现可以参考？请给出名称与链接。
Is there a similar implementation in other projects (Iris, Sodium, OptiFine, etc.)? Provide names and links.

## 可行性考虑 / Feasibility

- 与现有渲染管线的交互方式（如涉及 render pass、framebuffer、状态管理，请说明）
  Interaction with the existing render pipeline (render pass, framebuffer, state management):
- 可能影响的模组或光影包 / Potentially affected mods or shader packs:

## 补充说明 / Additional Context

其他想法或注意事项。
Other thoughts or notes.
